_comment: Bedrock's built-in particle materials, which no pack ships; the pack's particles.material derives from these. Inferred, not read from the game: particles_alpha cuts out with ALPHA_TEST, particles_blend alpha-blends, particles_add adds without depth writes; the pack's derived materials add ENABLE_FOG to particles_base and remove it from particles_alpha and particles_blend, so only those two fog. All are drawn double-sided.
